title: Replication package: Does Cross-Exchange Fragmentation Distort Cryptocurrency Risk Measures? Evidence from Venue Comparison and Stablecoin Micro-Depeg Prediction
description:
Replication code and processed datasets for the study of cross-venue fragmentation in centralized cryptocurrency markets and next-day stablecoin micro-depeg prediction. Includes the balanced daily BTC and ETH panel for Binance and Kraken (Feb 2024 - Feb 2026), the matched USDT/USD and USDC/USD panels, all analysis scripts, the Heliyon major-revision (2026) analyses, and the Heliyon round-2 (2026) analyses (variance decomposition with the covariance term, conditional slope of the interaction specification, and block-bootstrap intervals for out-of-sample performance).

Coinbase market data are not redistributed, in accordance with the Coinbase Market Data Terms of Use. The script src/restore_coinbase_columns.py retrieves the Coinbase daily closes from Coinbase's public API and rebuilds the three-venue files used in the paper exactly.
